sc: Underweight infant, normal examination, poor home, gains fast in hospital → Non-organic FTT
FTT, bulky foul stools after starting wheat, wasted buttocks → Coeliac disease
Short child, both parents short, normal velocity, bone age = age → Familial short stature
f: FTT: weight below the 3rd centile or crossing 2 major centile lines downward · usually under 2 years
Commonest: inadequate intake (undernutrition) · organic: coeliac, CF, CHD, renal (RTA), kala-azar, HIV, TB
Guided by history and examination · CBC, urine, stool · anti-tTG IgA (coeliac) · sweat chloride (CF) · HIV test
Feeding counselling, 100–120 kcal/kg/day plus catch-up · treat the cause · deworm (albendazole 400 mg, 200 mg at 1–2 yr)
Familial (bone age = age) · constitutional delay (bone age delayed, late puberty, normal final height) · short + overweight = endocrine
Thyroid function first · GH: IGF-1 + two stimulation tests (peak < 10 ng/mL) · short girl: karyotype (Turner)
trap: Breastfeeding does not cause FTT (poor technique does) · tests are chosen by the findings, not a routine panel · Marfan = tall, not short · check thyroid before GH tests
